title: Innde Dokkaande Ko adii Jibineede
intro: Natal nokku ceniɗo deƴƴuɗo keewɗo duwaawu tiiɗngu caggal duuɓi juutɗi e ndeenka. Gila e ko yi’aaka ina ummoo jaabawol jogiingol innde nde meeɗaa rokkeede, fodoore hakkille gila e duuɓi gadani e nguurndam maantinɗam dewal, yurmeende e laaɓal.
clues: Miin ko Alla e hoore mum inniraa mi hade am jibineede, innde nde hay gooto meeɗaa rokkeede ko adii kam.
Mi rokkaama jaabawol e ñaagunde tiiɗnde e jibnaaɓe mawɓe cikkatnooɓe iwdi ina yaaji.
Mi hokkaama hakkilo, kiita, e Binndi gila mi suka.
Miɗo joginoo golle e jibnaaɓe am, miɗo yurminoo woɗɓe, mi wonaano mawnikiniiɗo, mi wonaano ɗooftaare.
Alla wadii jam e am ñalnde jibinaa-mi, ñalnde maay-mi, ñalnde ummit-mi-mi e nguurndam.
Baaba am Zakariyya heɓi kabaaru belɗo e am e juuɗe maleykaaji nde o darii e juulde e nder suudu ceniindu (mihrab).

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
